public.text: The document does not reference the existing historical formal collaboration between SNOMED International and WHO on ICD-10/SNOMED CT cross-mapping, a collaboration that produced the authoritative map between the classification and terminology standard.  required by DPI-H and that is directly relevant to the cross-terminology governance challenge identified in this document. Similarly, the Regenstrief-SNOMED International LOINC Ontology collaboration is unacknowledged.
public.suggestedRevision: Add footnote or information box: "Historically SNOMED International and WHO collaborate on the production of authoritative cross-maps between SNOMED CT and ICD-10. These maps are available freely and are essential for a national Terminology Service supporting both clinical data capture (SNOMED CT) and administrative/statistical reporting (ICD-10). SNOMED International and Regenstrief additionally collaborate on SNOMED CT-LOINC concept-level alignment and collaboratively produce the LOINC Ontology. Countries implementing DPI-H should plan to incorporate these cross-maps into their Terminology Service rather than building custom mappings."
